data.title: Yas Golf Collection Residences
data.about:
The Yas Golf Collection Residences, a prestigious project by Aldar Properties, introduces a spectrum of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments, both furnished and unfurnished, on the scenic Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. 

Beyond the individual apartments, the development is a treasure trove of luxurious amenities, providing an enriched community experience steeped in the unique culture and history of Abu Dhabi.

characteristics_module.title: Architecturally Distinguished New Development.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusively crafted studio, 1, 2, & 3 bedroom residences, with furnished or unfurnished options.
  • Elite standard facilities and amenities at disposal.
  • Enclosed community ideal for family centric living.
  • Flexible and appealing payment structures.
  • Breathtaking vistas of Yas Island and surrounding environs.
  • Situated within a vibrant, emerging sector of the city.
  • Impeccable blend of comfort and style in residential design.
  • Security and serenity within a gated community.
  • Access to world class, resident exclusive amenities.

location_tile.title: Yas Golf Collection Residences in Yas Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Yas Golf Collection Residences is situated on Yas Island, a destination known for its vibrant energy, stunning landscapes, and array of world class attractions. This prime location in Abu Dhabi is not just a residential area but a lifestyle destination, offering residents an exquisite blend of leisure, entertainment, and retail experiences right on their doorstep.

  • 3 Minutes to Waters Edge
  • 4 Minutes to Ferrari World
  • 7 Minutes to Yas Mall
  • 10 Minutes to Yas Waterworld
  • 11 Minutes to Warner Brothers World
  • 15 Minutes to Abu Dhabi International Airport
  • 15 Minutes to Khalifa City
